name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Motorcycle Grand Prix circuit (2021-present): Grand Prix circuit without the final chicane, with the Turn 10 hairpin, 14 turns

start_finish.source: Start line: transverse white line at the front of the painted grid on the pit straight, identified in the PNOA orthophoto; coincides with OSM node 385973430 (raceway=start) of relation 21420925

width.status: Measured from orthoimagery pavement colour; median 27 m and Gaussian 6 m smoothed; gaps interpolated
